title: Validity of input-cell sources
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,T\in\mathbb{N}$. Let $\ell$ be a list of bit sources, each valid for input length $n$, width $W=\operatorname{snapWidth}(M)+5$, and block index $0$. For natural numbers $t,p$ with $p<|\ell|+2$, every source in the input-cell source list at time $t$ and position $p$ is valid for input length $n$, width $W$, and block index $t\bigl(k(2T+1)+|\ell|+3\bigr)+k(2T+1)+|\ell|+2+p$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet, with k work tapes
n and T are natural numbers
Every source in ℓ is valid for input length n, width snapWidth(M)+5, and block index 0
t and p are natural numbers
